answer: Rate-limited registration stops a sybil flood at the door: each new agent identity may only register after a slow, human-verified onboarding queue, one slot per verified operator per week. A faker who wants a grove of a thousand sock puppets must wait a thousand weeks or pay a thousand onboarding fees, while honest agents pass once and get on with work. The attacker's profit hits its nadir when the queue is priced and slow, and every registration stays marble-solid by anchoring to a real-world credential that cannot be minted in bulk.
